tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Conducting Topographical Survey of RTPS Plant area and fixing of wall mounting pictures to all floors of Green building at RTPS

itemList.description: Conducting Topographical survey by using DGPS (Differential Global Positioning System) & Drone surveys under engineering standard guidelines requires establishing high-precision ground controls, precise aerial overlap, and specific coordinate referencing. Key requirements include setting certified Ground Control Points (GCPs) via dual-frequency DGPS maintaining strict camera overlap during flight and processing data in standard geodetic datum’s. Tracing all features like boundaries ,elevation of permanenet structures, block levels, contours, buildings, tress, streams, roads, & other points/features etc, as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Establishment of permanent Ground Control Points (GCPs) using DGPS etc at locations approved by the Engineer-in-Charge. Submission of final survey reports and digital data in pen drive & 5 Hard copies of cad drawings, GIS database, and submission of all raw and processed data complete in all respects as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Including all labour, survey personnel, equipment, instruments, accessories, software, vehicles, and all other resources necessary for satisfactory completion of the work. Defective or inaccurate work shall be rectified or repeated without any additional payment as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Conducting survey for existing drain by Total Station including establishing Bench Marks, taking ground and invert levels, preparing longitudinal section, cross-sections, coordinates, and feasible location for discharge of storm water & waste water from higher elevation to lower elevation point. Scope of work also includes removing and re-fixing of drain cover slabs, cad drawings and submission of hard and soft copies complete as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge

Providing and fixing UV digitally printed acrylic signage/panel, using 8 mm thick clear/cast acrylic sheet of approved make and quality, cut to required size and shape, including high-resolution UV digital printing with UV-curable inks on the reverse/front face as per approved artwork, colour and sample.The acrylic sheet shall be machine cut with smooth/polished edges and shall be provided with accurately drilled holes wherever required. The panel shall be fixed to the wall/background with stainless steel (SS) grade 304 decorative studs/spacers, of approved diameter and projection, including SS screws, washers, suitable nylon rawl plugs/anchor fasteners and all necessary accessories.The rate shall include preparation of artwork, UV digital printing, 8 mm acrylic sheet, cutting, drilling, edge polishing, SS studs/spacers, screws, anchors, transportation, scaffolding/ladders wherever required, fixing, alignment, levelling and complete installation, all complete as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. The work shall be executed strictly as per approved drawing, design, colour, lettering, sample and instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing and fixing 10 mm thick sheet with UV-stabilised cast acrylic letters, numerals, logos, symbols, pictorials and graphic elements for exterior signage, of approved make, colour and finish, fabricated by precision CNC/laser cutting as per approved artwork, drawing and dimensions. The letters, logos, symbols and pictorial elements shall be accurately cut from 10 mm thick exterior-grade UV-stabilised cast acrylic sheet, having smooth, polished and uniform edges. Printed/coloured pictorials, where specified, shall be produced using suitable UV-resistant digital printing, vinyl graphics or approved colour finish suitable for exterior exposure.The completed letters and pictorial elements shall be fixed to the wall/background using SS 304 grade decorative studs/standoffs and suitable mechanical anchors, including SS screws, washers, spacers and other necessary fixing accessories. Additional exterior-grade adhesive may be provided wherever required.The item shall include artwork preparation, fabrication, CNC/laser cutting, pictorial/logo cutting, UV digital printing wherever specified, edge polishing, drilling, templates, SS 304 studs/standoffs, anchors, adhesive, transportation, labour, access equipment, fixing, alignment, levelling and complete installation, all as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge

Providing and fixing of Aluminium composite panel of approved make and colour for wall cladding for Brick/Rcc/stone walls & coloumns/beams with necessary aluminium frame works at required level made out of 50x25x4mm C section or equivalent. The panel should consist of 3mm thick non-halogenated FR grade mineral based polymer ( 2 hrs fire resistance as per ASTM E119-12 and clause B, S1, do as per ENT 13501-1sandwiched between 0.50 skins thick aluminium sheet making a total panel
thickness of 4mm. The surfaces will be finished with PVDF based coating on topsides and service coating on reverse sides would be in polyester paint. The system shall be fixed using GI brackets, aluminium L cleats and stainless steel bolts and nuts complete with spring washer and cap nuts and all other necessary accessories, sealing shall be done with necessary rods etc., complete
